test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

(a) All leaders are corrupt.

(b) Some women are leaders.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some women are corrupt.

II. All those corrupt are women.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.
Both conclusion I and II follow.

solution:
**Statements:**

(a) All leaders are corrupt.

(b) Some women are leaders.

**Possible Venn diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0627eceb2c8097465b46be0b8c818c2745067cb947b753d16d7564ccdbc08f61.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some women are corrupt →** True **(Since some women are leaders and all leaders are corrupt)

II. All those corrupt are women → False (It is not true because all those corrupt cannot be women)

Hence, **'option 2'** is the correct answer.
